title: USGS Little Arkansas River near Sedgwick calibration table, 2004–2014
source_document: USGS Office of Surface Water Technical Memorandum 2016.07 / Office of Water Quality Technical Memorandum 2016.10
source_location: Attachment B, model archive summary; 120-row calibration table, printed pages 24–25 (PDF pages 24–25 when counted from 1)
station_name: Little Arkansas River near Sedgwick, Kansas

discharge_conversion.definition: 1 international foot = 0.3048 metres; cubic conversion is exact

date_precision: date only; no clock time or timezone is supplied by the published table
pairing: Each numbered published table row supplies concurrent SSC, turbidity and discharge. Original row numbers identify distinct samples, including repeated dates. A shared calendar date does not combine samples or establish independent hydrologic events.

transcription.method: Extract published table text, select original raw SSC/TURB/Q columns, preserve printed decimal values and row order; discard no rows. No published rounded logarithms used for fitting.
transcription.limitations: These are values at the precision printed in the USGS model archive summary, not the original laboratory or sensor CSV byte stream. Original author removed seven samples before this published120-row table; their complete original values are not contained here.

published_model.equation: log10(SSC mg/L) = 0.262 + 0.933 log10(turbidity FNU) + 0.0431 log10(discharge ft3/s)
published_model.comparison: Published coefficients are rounded. Re-fitting uses the raw columns at published precision; convert discharge units before comparing the intercept.

course.full_calibration: All120 published samples assigned to training to reproduce the archive coefficients; this is a calibration reproduction.
course.temporal_validation: Separate study: dates before2012-01-01 assigned to training; dates from2012-01-01 assigned to validation. This is a new explicitly declared temporal holdout exercise, not the author's published cross-validation or independent new monitoring data.

license: United States Geological Survey federal publication; source attribution retained.
